name: Fund Order Type 5 Code
definition: Specifies the category of the investment fund order.

NSPN.name: Normal Staff Portion
NSPN.definition: That part of an investment fund order attributed to a normal staff portion.

NCPN.name: Normal Client Portion
NCPN.definition: That part of an investment fund order attributed to a normal client portion.

SWSP.name: Staff With Savings Plan
SWSP.definition: That part of an investment fund order attributed to a staff member with a savings plan.

CWSP.name: Client With Savings Plan
CWSP.definition: That part of an investment fund order attributed to a client with a savings plan.
